images.title: James Keauiluna Kaulia
images.caption: James Keauiluna Kaulia, c. 1893. The photograph predates the 1897 Palace Square speech and is shown as a near-match portrait of the same person, not as an image of the event.
images.source_record_label: Library of Congress, Representative Committee of Delegates of the Hawaiian People, c. 1893; J.K. Kaulia identified in the group portrait
images.source_image_access_note: Public-domain crop of Kaulia from the archival group photograph; the Library of Congress catalog record remains source authority.
images.rights_note: Library of Congress lists no known restrictions on publication for the source group photograph; Wikimedia marks the crop public domain in the United States.
images.color_reason: The grayscale/albumen source does not establish the specific colors of Kaulia's suit, waistcoat, gloves, background, or surrounding people. Color would add invention without enough historical value for this first feed use.

images.title: ʻIolani Palace
images.caption: ʻIolani Palace around 1890, several years before the September 1897 Palace Square meeting. Shown as place context, not as a photograph of that meeting.
images.source_record_label: Hawaiʻi State Archives, PPWD-1-8-010, Buildings Government - Iolani Palace, c. 1890, Theodore P. Severin
images.source_image_access_note: Web access copy of the c. 1890 Severin palace photograph; Hawaiʻi State Archives record PPWD-1-8-010 remains source authority.
images.rights_note: The source photograph dates to c. 1890. The project preserves the Hawaiʻi State Archives record and provenance rather than asserting broader licensing terms beyond the source record.
images.color_reason: A useful color reconstruction would require period-specific evidence for stone, trim, roof, grounds, and other visible materials. Current visual evidence is not enough to justify a historical-color claim.

images.title: Pounding poi - preparing dinner, Hawaiian Islands
images.caption: Pounding poi in Hawaiʻi, 1896. This same-era daily-life photograph is part of the Image OS proving set but is not forced into the September 1897 political feed until a grounded post relationship earns it.
images.source_record_label: Library of Congress, Pounding poi - preparing dinner, Hawaiian Islands, 1896, LC-DIG-stereo-1s12133
images.source_image_access_note: Large JPEG digital file from the original stereograph, provided by the Library of Congress.
images.rights_note: Library of Congress lists no known restrictions on publication.
images.color_reason: The source does not establish specific colors for clothing, food vessels, vegetation, structures, or skin rendering under the original photographic process. Generic colorization would overstate certainty and could amplify a staged-tourist reading of the scene.
